analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc decomposition of 369 existing internal ellipsoid residual bounds with independent snapshot residual recomputation; no refitting or new experiment

decomposition_rule.actual_residual: Recompute abs(observed_y - snapshot_prediction_float) from the independent prediction-box point records; do not derive it as bound minus shift
decomposition_rule.identity: For every available point, ellipsoid_residual_upper_bound = recomputed_actual_residual + ellipsoid_prediction_shift within numerical tolerance
decomposition_rule.shift_share: ellipsoid_prediction_shift / ellipsoid_residual_upper_bound when the bound is positive
decomposition_rule.zero_bound: If actual residual, shift and bound are all zero, retain an undefined share rather than assigning 0 percent
decomposition_rule.classification: prediction_shift_dominant when share >= 0.5; snapshot_residual_dominant when share < 0.5; undefined_zero_bound otherwise
decomposition_rule.point_identity: Match comparison and prediction points by dataset, fold, x and observed_y; require equal point counts per available case

scope_rule.rooted_folds: Retain as unavailable cases, not as zero points, zero bounds or successful certificates

prohibitions: No refitting, retuning or changing of frozen bounds
No deriving actual residual as bound minus shift
No conversion of rooted unavailable folds into zero points or successful bounds
No probability, variance-decomposition, physical-mechanism or universal internal-versus-external ranking claims
